blurb: Relax, see the sites, and learn the unique history of the Thimbles Islands on a 45 minute narrated.

quotes.text: Captain Matt is a local who grew up in the Thimbles. His smaller boat can navigate the inlets better and get closer than the bigger boats. Matt gives a colorful and personal account of what it is like to live in these stunning little islands. I highly recommend this tour if you are looking for a more personal and less touristy cruise. Great trip!
